## About
D & J Enterprises is a lighting and electrical specialist based in Denver. We work for homeowners and for commercial clients, including apartment buildings and offices, on repairs, installations and build outs.
Our electricians are licensed and certified. Reviewers name Sam, our installer, for careful, professional work, and one mentions Don, the owner, for a quick response and getting them on the schedule.
We're open weekdays. Give us a call or send a short message about what you need, and we'll get back to you promptly.

## Services
- Lighting repairs and installation: Lighting sales, repairs and installation, including chandeliers, pendants, recessed cans, under cabinet and exterior lighting.
- Ceiling fan installation: Ceiling fans with or without lights, plus bathroom and attic fans. One reviewer said their new fan has no wobbles or squeaks.
- Panel upgrades: Electrical panel upgrades for homes and commercial buildings.
- Electric car charger installation: Charger installation for homeowners with an electric car.
- Energy saving LED retrofits: LED retrofits, fluorescent and LED fixture repair, occupancy sensors and energy savings audits for commercial and apartment buildings.
- Security and camera surveillance: Security camera work for homes and businesses, along with cable, phone and low voltage lines.
- Tenant finishes and improvements: Electrical and lighting work for commercial tenant finishes, office lighting and build outs.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on homes or businesses?
A: Both. We do residential work for homeowners and commercial work for offices and apartment buildings.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How do I get in touch?
A: Give us a call, or send a brief message through the contact form about what you need, and we'll get back to you promptly.
